id: 07_Study of Open Circuit and Short Circuit Conditions in an AC Circuit Basic Electr
title: 交流电路的开路与短路（国内版）
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/07_Study of Open Circuit and Short Circuit Conditions in an AC Circuit Basic Electr.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/07_Study of Open Circuit and Short Circuit Conditions in an AC Circuit Basic Electr（国内版）/src.py

points.K6: 电流表和开关组成短路支路
points.K7: 电压表并在灯 1 两端
points.S2: 熔断器、断路器、漏电保护器
points.S4: 通电前：查线、提醒、手离开

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上两盏灯泡、一只电流表、一只电压表，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with two light bulbs on a wiring board, an analog ammeter and an analog voltmeter, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课做交流电路的开路与短路实验。
overlay: 交流电路的开路与短路

shots.scene: 断开的电路和被短接的电路两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a circuit with a gap, and a circuit with a wire bridging across a lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 开路和短路，到底有什么不同？

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一根导线，想把插座的两个孔连起来试试“短路”
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a loose wire near a wall socket as if to bridge its two holes.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：短路？拿根线把插座一连不就行了。

shots.scene: 导线短接插座的图标冒出火花，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wire bridging a socket's two holes with a big spark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这样做非常危险，绝对不行！

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指向实验台上的两盏灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at the two lamps on the lab bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：实验里的短路，是有讲究的。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们来看看，安全的短路实验怎么做。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着开路、短路两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the open circuit icon and the short circuit icon.
shots.narration: 目的：观察开路和短路时电压电流的变化。

shots.scene: 实验台上：交流电流表、交流电压表、两盏白炽灯、一个单极开关
shots.prompt_en: On the bench: an AC ammeter, an AC voltmeter, two incandescent bulbs in holders and a single pole switch. No people.
shots.narration: 器材：交流电流表、电压表、两盏灯、一个开关。

shots.scene: 两只表盘上都有波浪符号，旁边一只万用表打问号
shots.prompt_en: Two meter dials both marked with a wave symbol, and a multimeter beside them with a small question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 用交流表；没有电压表可用万用表代替。

shots.scene: 接线板上的电源区：一个双极开关和一个熔断器
shots.prompt_en: The supply section of a wiring board: a double pole switch and a fuse holder, with line and neutral terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 单相交流电经双极开关和熔断器引出。

shots.scene: 两端带插头的连接导线打绿勾，两根裸线头打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a connecting lead with proper plugs on both ends with a green check, and two bare wire ends crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 连接导线要带合适的插头，不用裸线头。

shots.scene: 电路图：相线接灯 1，灯 1 接灯 2，灯 2 接中性线
shots.prompt_en: A circuit diagram icon: the line wire goes to lamp one, lamp one to lamp two, and lamp two to the neutral wire. No people.
shots.narration: 相线接灯一，灯一接灯二，灯二接零线。

shots.scene: 两盏灯首尾相连成一串
shots.prompt_en: Two lamp icons connected end to end in a single series loop. No people.
shots.narration: 两盏灯串联，构成主回路。

shots.section_title: 电流表和开关组成短路支路
shots.scene: 从灯 1 前端引线到电流表，再到开关，回到灯 1 后端
shots.prompt_en: The diagram highlights a branch: from the front of lamp one through an ammeter and a switch back to the back of lamp one. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表和开关串起来，跨接在灯一两端。
overlay: 电流表和开关组成短路支路

shots.section_title: 电流表和开关组成短路支路
shots.scene: 支路导线画得比主回路粗
shots.prompt_en: The branch wire drawn thicker than the main loop wires. No people.
shots.narration: 这条支路用粗一点的导线。

shots.section_title: 电流表和开关组成短路支路
shots.scene: 开关后端接到灯 1 后端或灯 2 前端，两点用同色圆点标出
shots.prompt_en: The diagram marks the back of lamp one and the front of lamp two with the same colored dot. No people.
shots.narration: 接灯一后端或灯二前端，都是同一点。

shots.section_title: 电压表并在灯 1 两端
shots.scene: 电压表用细导线并接在灯 1 两端
shots.prompt_en: The diagram shows a voltmeter connected with thinner wires across lamp one. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表用细线，并在灯一两端。
overlay: 电压表并在灯 1 两端

shots.section_title: 电压表并在灯 1 两端
shots.scene: 电压表和电流表的量程旋钮各指向合适挡
shots.prompt_en: The voltmeter and ammeter range terminals highlighted on suitable ranges. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表、电流表都选合适的量程。

shots.scene: 先画出串联回路，再加上并联支路的两步图
shots.prompt_en: Two step icons: first the series loop drawn, then the parallel branch added. No people.
shots.narration: 接线顺序：先接串联，后接并联。

shots.scene: 接线板上两盏灯、开关、两只表的实物
shots.prompt_en: The real setup on the bench: two bulbs, a switch, an ammeter and a voltmeter connected with plug leads. No people.
shots.narration: 实物就是这样：两盏灯，一开关，两只表。

shots.scene: 开关 S1 处于断开位置，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of switch S1 in the off position with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 通电时，开关 S1 必须先断开。

shots.scene: 电压表接线柱被圈出，箭头指向下刻度
shots.prompt_en: The voltmeter's connected terminal circled, an arrow pointing to the lower scale on the dial. No people.
shots.narration: 先看表接在哪个量程，读对应刻度。

shots.scene: 表盘一段放大，数小格
shots.prompt_en: A magnified section of the dial showing small divisions between two numbered marks. No people.
shots.narration: 再数小格，算出读数。

shots.scene: S1 断开，两盏灯都微微发亮
shots.prompt_en: With switch S1 open, both bulbs glow dimly. No people.
shots.narration: S1 断开，这就是开路状态。

shots.scene: 电压表指针偏转较大
shots.prompt_en: The voltmeter needle deflected well up the dial. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表有较大读数。

shots.scene: 电流表指针停在零
shots.prompt_en: The ammeter needle resting at zero. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表读数为零。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着开路卡片：电压高，电流零
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with an up arrow for voltage and a zero for current.
shots.narration: 开路：电压最大，电流为零。

shots.scene: 小研按着开关手柄把 S1 闭合，灯 1 熄灭，灯 2 变亮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes switch S1 by its handle; lamp one goes dark and lamp two glows brighter.
shots.narration: 闭合 S1，灯一被短接，熄灭了。

shots.scene: 电流表指针偏转
shots.prompt_en: The ammeter needle deflected to a clear reading. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表有了读数。

shots.scene: 电压表指针回到零
shots.prompt_en: The voltmeter needle back at zero. No people.
shots.narration: 灯一两端电压变成零。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着短路卡片：电流大，电压零
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with an up arrow for current and a zero for voltage.
shots.narration: 短路：电流最大，电压为零。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着三张空白问题卡
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds three blank question cards.
shots.narration: 口试常问三个问题。

shots.scene: 开路时两灯都暗，短路时灯 1 灭、灯 2 亮的对比图
shots.prompt_en: Two comparison icons: both bulbs dim with the switch open; lamp one dark and lamp two bright with the switch closed. No people.
shots.narration: 开路两灯分压都暗，短路灯二全压变亮。

shots.scene: 动铁式和动圈式表芯剖面
shots.prompt_en: Two cutaway icons: a moving iron meter movement and a moving coil meter movement. No people.
shots.narration: 还要会比较动铁式和动圈式仪表。

shots.scene: 空白结果表，只有开关、亮灯、灭灯图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank results table with only switch icons and lamp-on and lamp-off icons in the cells. No people.
shots.narration: 把开关状态、电压、电流、灯的状态填进表。

shots.scene: 开路和短路两张卡片并排
shots.prompt_en: The open circuit card and the short circuit card side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 开路电压大电流零，短路电流大电压零。

shots.scene: 灯 2 仍串在短路支路的回路里，像一道闸门限流
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon showing lamp two still in series with the shorted branch, drawn like a gate limiting the current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 实验只短接灯一，灯二还在限流。

shots.scene: 相线和中性线直接相连，电流箭头暴涨、导线发红
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the line and neutral wires joined directly, a huge current arrow and a red-hot wire. No people.
shots.narration: 电源直接短路，电流会大得惊人。

shots.scene: 导线发热、电弧、起火三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an overheating wire, an electric arc flash, and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 导线过热、电弧、起火，瞬间发生。

shots.scene: 用导线短接电源两端的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wire placed across power supply terminals, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 严禁拿导线直接短接电源。

shots.section_title: 熔断器、断路器、漏电保护器
shots.scene: 熔断器里的熔丝断开
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a fuse whose wire has melted apart. No people.
shots.narration: 熔断器：电流过大，熔丝熔断。
overlay: 熔断器、断路器、漏电保护器

shots.section_title: 熔断器、断路器、漏电保护器
shots.scene: 断路器手柄跳到下方
shots.prompt_en: A miniature circuit breaker icon with its handle tripped down. No people.
shots.narration: 断路器：过载短路，自动跳闸。

shots.section_title: 熔断器、断路器、漏电保护器
shots.scene: 漏电保护器上有一个试验按钮被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A residual current device icon with its test button highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 漏电保护器：有人触电漏电，迅速断电。

shots.section_title: 熔断器、断路器、漏电保护器
shots.scene: 老李按下漏电保护器的试验按钮，开关跳开
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the test button on a residual current device and it trips off.
shots.narration: 按规定定期按试验键，检查它灵不灵。

shots.scene: 断路器跳闸，阿杰伸手要马上推上去
shots.prompt_en: A breaker trips; the young male student immediately reaches to push it back up.
shots.narration: 跳闸了，阿杰想马上推上去。

shots.scene: 反复强行合闸的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand repeatedly forcing a breaker handle up, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能反复强行合闸。

shots.scene: 小研先断开实验台开关，再查找接错的导线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off the bench and looks for a wrongly connected lead.
shots.narration: 先断开电路，查明原因。

shots.scene: 小研向王老师报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports the trip to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 报告老师，排除故障后再由老师恢复。

shots.section_title: 通电前：查线、提醒、手离开
shots.scene: 王老师对照电路图检查接线和开关位置
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the wiring and the switch position against a blank circuit diagram.
shots.narration: 通电前，请老师检查接线。
overlay: 通电前：查线、提醒、手离开

shots.section_title: 通电前：查线、提醒、手离开
shots.scene: 阿杰举手示意同组同学，大家双手离开接线板
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to alert his teammates, and everyone lifts their hands away from the wiring board.
shots.narration: 合闸前提醒同组：要通电了。

shots.section_title: 通电前：查线、提醒、手离开
shots.scene: 确认无人接触电路后才合闸
shots.prompt_en: Only after checking that no one is touching the board does the young male student switch on.
shots.narration: 确认没人碰电路，再合闸。

shots.section_title: 通电前：查线、提醒、手离开
shots.scene: 通电时伸手改线的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand moving a lead on a powered board, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通电后不改线，要改先断电。

shots.scene: 实验结束：先断开开关 S1
shots.prompt_en: End of experiment: the female graduate student first switches S1 off by its handle.
shots.narration: 做完了：先断开实验开关。

shots.scene: 再拉下实验台总电源
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student then switches off the bench main power.
shots.narration: 再断开实验台总电源。

shots.scene: 最后拆线，导线挂回架子
shots.prompt_en: Finally the young male student removes the leads and hangs them back on a rack.
shots.narration: 最后拆线，器材归位。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着墙上的总闸和红色急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the main switch box and a red emergency stop button on the lab wall.
shots.narration: 进实验室先认清总闸和急停按钮。

shots.scene: 阿杰触电倒在台边，小研拍下急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slumps beside the bench after an electric shock; the female graduate student slaps the red emergency stop button.
shots.narration: 有人触电，立即断电，不徒手拉人。

shots.scene: 老周打电话，老李在旁照护
shots.prompt_en: The older man calls on a mobile phone with a blank screen while the facility engineer, trained in first aid, attends to the young male student.
shots.narration: 拨打 120，受过培训的人施救。

shots.scene: 接线板冒烟，老李拉闸后用二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The wiring board starts smoking; the facility engineer pulls the main switch and uses a carbon dioxide extinguisher.
shots.narration: 电气起火先断电，火大撤离打 119。

shots.scene: 小研向王老师报告，保卫处值班员记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the safety administrator while the security officer writes on a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 开路和短路两张卡片
shots.prompt_en: The open circuit card and the short circuit card side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 开路电压大电流零，短路电流大电压零。

shots.scene: 串联主回路和并联支路的接线顺序图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the series loop first, then the parallel branch, with plug leads. No people.
shots.narration: 带插头导线，先串后并，S1 先断开。

shots.scene: 熔断器、断路器、漏电保护器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fuse, a circuit breaker and a residual current device. No people.
shots.narration: 真短路很危险，保护装置别乱动。

shots.scene: 提醒同组、断电顺序、急停按钮三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a raised hand alert, a numbered power-off sequence, and a red emergency stop button. No people.
shots.narration: 通电先提醒，结束按顺序，应急先断电。

shots.scene: 欣欣在已断电、导线归位的实验台前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a switched-off bench with all leads hung neatly on the rack.
shots.narration: 懂得开路短路，用电更安心，下次见！
